references.text: The Lord came down on Mount Sinai in fire, and the smoke rose like the smoke from a furnace. This describes the same event where God spoke face to face with the people from the fire.
The Lord spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. This shows the intimate communication between God and humans, face to face.
The Lord spoke to you from the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice. This parallels the speech from the fire on the mountain.
Has any people heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire as you have heard, and yet lived? This refers to the unique experience of hearing God speak from the fire.
These words the Lord spoke to your entire assembly on the mountain, from the fire, cloud, and darkness, with a loud voice. It confirms the context of God's speech from the fire.
God spoke all these words and said. This is the beginning of the Ten Commandments, which God spoke directly to the people.
Reference to the Sinai experience with fire and darkness, and a voice that spoke words. Points to the same event where God spoke to the people.
